about_the_game:
This is a donation option for a free and open-source app Bosca Ceoil: The Blue Album. There are no changes or additional content inside of the application associated with this purchase.

If you want to support the development of Bosca Ceoil Blue, you can use this option to make a one-time donation to the project. As a token of acknowledgement of your support you will receive a non-personalized poem!

Thank you for your generosity <3
